method: Rare Lv1 encounters in higher-level areas, the pattern the original uses (docs/reverse-engineering/rare-level-one-encounters.md). tools/import_encounters.py merges this file into the encounter catalog. Each entry adds one group {Lv1 enemy weight 1, companion weight 1} to its area with area weight 1; alone_group_id adds a second group with only the Lv1 enemy (as many copies as its row allows, like the original's single Lv1 groups in 加鲁卡, 吉鲁岛 and 沙姆岛), also area weight 1, so hunts that only enter troops of Lv1 enemies (只进无其他敌人的遇敌) find it too. Entries without a companion are alone already. areas multiplies an area's existing group weights (ratios unchanged) so that weight 1 is about 1% like the reference. origin: original_area = the pet has an original wild row in this area at a higher level (补充); added = no original wild area in an imported map (原版无野外，非原版).
